home.role: Full-stack developer & AI engineer — I build intelligent web experiences that bridge cutting-edge AI with production-ready code.

about.profileText: Full-stack Developer specializing in the intersection of modern web development (MERN stack) and Artificial Intelligence. I am passionate about the potential of data and love the challenge of optimizing and deploying advanced AI models into real-world applications. I am looking to join dynamic teams and work on inspiring projects where I can tackle complex engineering challenges and build high-impact solutions.

experience.description: Developing new features using React.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, focusing on constant refactoring and clean code best practices. Applied advanced AI knowledge to integrate innovative web solutions. Implemented performance optimization, feature testing, and maintained workflows in Make.com with external API integrations.

Developed optimized interfaces, integrated third-party APIs, and worked with blockchain technologies (Web3, smart contracts, and wallets). Handled Big Data processing for data cleaning, analysis, and visualization. Designed and maintained backend architectures using MVC patterns.

Built web applications using React.js and Next.js, integrating APIs and developing backends with Node.js and Express. Implemented secure user authentication and designed intuitive, user-friendly interfaces to present complex data.

educationList.title: Master's in Advanced AI

educationList.title: Applied AI Course

educationList.description: Completed a Higher National Diploma (Pearson HND) in Computing and AI, graduating with Distinction. Acquired a robust foundation in software engineering, databases, web development, and security, while exploring big data, cloud computing, and machine learning.
